summary: v1.2 (FoxPro deep restructure) end-to-end verified. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass (~6s) covering all v1.2 features: 18 seeded account groups with correct fcode/lcode/nature (CAPITAL A/C 1-50, SALES PARTY 350-1199, COLD STORAGE 2200-2400, etc.), /account-groups/{gid}/next-code endpoint (returns next free code in group range, increments after party added, returns 404 for invalid group), Party creation with full FoxPro fields (code, group_id, group_name, place, gstin, pan, cstno, mpstno, alt_name, address2, opening_balance, opening_qty, rate), Inward register CRUD with date+cold_storage_id filters, Purchase bill with full FoxPro fields (lot_no, due_date, gp_no, truck_no, driver_name, bilty_no, garage, no_of_bag, bag_pack_q, agent_name, buyer_name, remark1/2; charges hamali_rt+amt, bhada_rt+amt, dalali_rt+amt, mandi rt+amt, cartage_amt, discount, rebate; item bag/pack/weight/wb/ghat/nwt all round-trip correctly), Trial Balance /api/reports/trial-balance returns >=18 sections sorted by fcode each with rows+dr_total+cr_total + grand totals, RAMOTAR BAGRI correctly appears under SALES PARTY 350-1199. Seeded accounts CASH IN HAND (301) + BANK A/C (302) verified. Backward compat: old bill format still saves. Frontend: login OK, /account-groups shows 18 groups split into 4 nature columns (Asset 8, Liability 3, Income 2, Expense 5) with CODE RANGE column, /parties opens 'Naya Khata / Ledger' modal with Group dropdown + Code + Name + Type + Alt Name (GL_NAME1) + Place (GL_PLACE) + Phone + Address1 + Address2 + GSTIN (F_G_L_NO) + PAN + CST NO + MP STATE TAX + Opening Balance + Opening Qty + Default Rate. /inward page renders with Date/Ref/Lot No/Cold Storage/Item/Bags/Weight columns + 'Nayi Inward' button. /trial-balance renders all 18 groups grouped sections with Code/Narration/Debit (₹)/Credit (₹) columns + Group Total rows + RAMOTAR BAGRI visible at code 350 under SALES PARTY. /bills?type=purchase opens 'Purchase Entry (कच्चा खरीद)' modal with ALL FoxPro fields: E.Date, S.Date, Lot No, GP No, Due Date, Payment Cond, Seller/Buyer/Agent dropdowns, Truck No, Driver, Bilty, Garage, No. of Bags; item table Item Name | Bag Pack | Bag | Pack | Weight | W.B. | Ghat | Net Wt | Rate | Amount; Additions panel (Hamali x bags, Cartage x bags, Bhada x Qtl, Mandi Tax %, Dalali/Arhat %, Garage x bags, Loading, Brokerage Dalali, Other Charges); Deductions panel (Discount, Rebate, Less, Advance Paid); Remark 1, Remark 2; live Subtotal + Additions - Deductions = Total Amount summary.

minor.issue: If max(used)+1 falls in an outsider's range (e.g. wrong codes saved manually), the function does not validate that nxt is still <= lcode in the < f branch; minor edge case
No uniqueness check on (group_id, code) - duplicates can be inserted via API (UI does call next-code so practically OK, but API allows it)
cold_storage_id not validated against parties collection (orphan id can be saved)
_compute_party_balance + _compute_account_balance called per row in O(N) loop - acceptable for kaccha arhat scale

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by Emergent dev instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> for {g.name}+{g.fcode}-{g.lcode}. Dev-only warning, functionally OK. Same root cause as v1.1 iteration_2 report.
Still uses native <select> and <input type=date> instead of shadcn Select/Calendar (intentional - dense desktop FoxPro look)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1005 lines - exceeds 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/ subpackage (auth.py, parties.py, items.py, bills.py, rokad.py, accounts.py, journal.py, inward.py, reports.py, backup.py, settings.py).
Trial Balance scans entire bills + rokad + journal collections per ledger row -> O(L * (B+R+J)). For >1000 ledgers this will get slow; consider precomputing balances or a single aggregation pipeline.
next_code_in_group only checks max(used)+1 - if codes are deleted out of order, gaps are not reused. Probably matches FoxPro ECODE behavior so acceptable.
PartyIn / BillIn / BillItem models have grown large with many optional/default fields. Consider grouping (e.g. PartyAddress, BillCharges sub-models) for clarity.
All POST handlers consistently use {'_id': 0} projection. /api/parties create_party returns doc with .pop('_id', None) after copy - safe pattern.
Inward endpoints follow established CRUD pattern - good consistency.
Trial Balance correctly handles orphan rows (no group_id) into UNCATEGORIZED section.
